'''Hammer Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Captain [[Yunaali]] flew in Hammer Squadron under callsign "Blue Mother".<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]|Black Boxes, White Ice|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>
